message.content: All three in-scope claims (cancellation accuracy c1, rounding budget c2, finiteness c3) were directly tested with adversarial extreme/subnormal/signed-zero inputs and rebutted with runtime evidence; the Skeptic reviewed the latest evidence and recorded no new claims, and no open claims remain. The key structural fact — FP16×FP16 products are exact in FP32, so numerators are computed exactly and only the scale sum and final division round (~1.5 ulp, well within the 5e-7 budget) — makes the kernel sound over the full contract domain.
